criteria.scope: 164 already-observed scenarios, two seeds; regression only, no new holdout claim.
criteria.workflow: All exact positive intents, specified decisions, strict drafts and workflows.
criteria.explanation: Every reason is native-bound: source-backed V8 or neutral decision-only.
criteria.honesty: Neutral reasons never upgrade source semantics or count as interpretation.
criteria.safety: All preapproval states and outside sentinels unchanged. No retries/raw repairs.
criteria.gate: Passing requires separate browser, install and package checks for release.
criteria.stop: One frozen release policy. No retuning after model observations.
